- **[system-design/system-design-data-architecture]**: Choose and scale the data layer: SQL versus NoSQL per access pattern, single data ownership, replication and read scaling, partition key choice, hot partition and celebrity key mitigation. Use when selecting a store, planning sharding, or fixing a data-tier bottleneck.

Use when sizing a service, provisioning infrastructure, or checking that a design survives peak load.
